Only methods declared in sugar-serve-protocol/src, or inherited from a parent declared there, are listed. A type that extends a class outside that tree, such as \RuntimeException, does not show the methods of that class.

SugarCraft\ServeProtocol

Protocol final class

The candy-code.v1 serve protocol's wire constants.

SugarCraft\ServeProtocol\Auth

TokenFile final class

The read path of the serve server's bearer token file.

MethodSummary
static read(string $dir): ?stringThe stored token, or null when there is no usable one: the file is absent, is a symbolic link or not a regular file, or its trimmed content is not a 64-character lowercase hex token. A null return tells the host to mint a fresh token.

SugarCraft\ServeProtocol\Discovery

DiscoveryRecordReader final class

The read-only half of candy-code's Server\DiscoveryFile::read: it finds the server.json discovery record and decodes it, and nothing more.

MethodSummary
static read(string $path): ?arrayThe decoded record at $path, or null when there is none or it is not a record: the path is absent, a symbolic link, or not a regular file, or it is not JSON within MAX_DEPTH that decodes to an array. A torn or hand-edited file is no server.

LiveRecord final class

The URL of a running serve process, read from its discovery record.

MethodSummary
static url(string $stateDir): ?stringThe record's url when the process it names is still running, else null.

ProcessIdentity final class

Whether a pid is still the process a discovery record was written for.

MethodSummary
static isSameProcess(int $pid, ?int $startTime): bool

StateDirReader final class

Locates an existing serve state directory without creating it.

MethodSummary
static existing(string $path): ?stringThe trailing-slash-trimmed path when it is an existing private directory, null when nothing exists at $path.

SugarCraft\ServeProtocol\Support

PrivateDirCheck final class

The read-side refusal rules for a per-user private directory: it must be a real directory (not a symlink or a file), owned by the running user, and mode 0700. Mirrors the refusal half of candy-code's Support\PrivateDir; creating or repairing the directory stays with the host.

MethodSummary
static refusal(string $dir, string $label, ?int $uid = null): ?stringWhy $dir is not a usable private directory, or null when it is one. $uid defaults to the running user; tests pass another to exercise the ownership rule.

SugarCraft\ServeProtocol\Url

WebsocketUrl final class

Turns the address a server prints (or a browser opens) into the ws(s) URL the serve protocol is dialled at.

MethodSummary
static from(string $url): ?stringws://host:port/ws for an http(s):// or ws(s):// address, or null when $url is neither. A bracketed IPv6 host is kept bracketed.
